Description

 

Equipe Nucleo is the latest running shoe designed for urban runners that live the city as their playground to train on, while thinking about the next challenge to come. “Nucleo” as the main feature - the intersole, core of this sneaker that stands out for its responsiveness and lightweight.

The intersole made with ourdd anima technology is engineered to provide the best performance, while taking care of feet protection and stability. Dd anima technology ensures a high degree of cushioning; High Rebound Compound increases the intersole responsiveness of 30% and reduces its weight for the 20%.

The sole is made in anti-abrasive rubber, with the special water-resistant Duratech 5000 compound on the heel.

Sizing

  • Length: Runs small; most runners will want a half size up
  • Width and toebox: Ample toebox room, neither notably wide nor narrow, with comfortable volume. A wide version is offered and is the better starting point for wide feet.
  • Fit notes: Reviewers found it ran short in their usual size and recommend a half size up, and several specialty retailers echo that. A rigid heel counter and the stock lacing give secure heel hold with no slippage. A standard everyday-trainer fit with no break-in required.

Atomo is the first technical running shoe made in Italy in the last 30 years. 

The new Atomo V7000 boasts the best cushioning and comfort – outstanding features of all Diadora running products – in addition to amazing lightness and reactivity, guaranteed by the use of a new technology: the special DD anima compound. Designed to meet all needs, merging performance and comfort in one shoe.

Highlights:

  • Low drop cushioning
  • Weight: 260 gr / 9.2 oz (size 9 UK)
  • Drop: 5 mm (0.20 in)

Sizing

  • Length: Guidance conflicts: some sources say true to size, others including the brand's own guide suggest sizing up. Worth trying on
  • Width and toebox: A narrow-leaning forefoot with a moderately narrow toebox that some find tight, with normal heel and midfoot width. Standard width only.
  • Fit notes: A low-volume, snug shoe over the midfoot and instep, best suited to narrow-to-medium feet. It does need break-in, roughly 20 miles, after which the fit relaxes. Higher-volume feet should try it on first.

Description

Most people don’t make a routine out of a physically demanding activity that requires persistent effort to get any good at. Even fewer do that just for fun. It’s like we’ve always said – runners aren’t normal. We designed the 860 to keep up with the demands placed on shoes by the dedication of the stability-minded every day runner. The latest entry in the series, the Fresh Foam X 860v13, augments the pinnacle cushioning experience of Fresh Foam X with a supportive medial post to provide essential stability. Built for reliability over the long haul and sustained comfort over all distances, the 860 is a true go-to shoe.

Features
  • Fresh Foam X midsole foam with approximately 3% bio-based content delivers our most cushioned Fresh Foam experience for incredible comfort. Bio-based content is made from renewable resources to help reduce our carbon footprint.
  • Structured and breathable engineered mesh upper
  • Reflective accents designed to catch the light
  • Internal gusseted tongue for a secure fit
  • 10 mm drop; due to variances created during the development and manufacturing processes, all references to 10 mm drop are approximate

Sizing

  • Length: True to size
  • Width and toebox: An average-width toebox with a notably accommodating midfoot and a comparatively narrow heel. Multiple widths offered in men's and women's.
  • Fit notes: A relaxed, roomy upper that holds well, a minimal but effective heel counter for a stability shoe, and only a few runs of break-in. Sizing feedback is not unanimous, with some testers wanting a half size up and some wide-footed runners finding the standard width short on forefoot room, so a try-on is worthwhile.

Flawless feel. Effortless support.

It's comfort and support over everything with the Guide 16. Perfectly balanced with cushioning where you need it, this shoe is truly built to do it all. Experience a personalized fit and feel the minute you put it on.

 

FEATURES & BENEFITS

  • PWRRUN foam midsole means a softer stack of cushion for our most comfortable run yet
  • Transitions effortlessly from heel to toe
  • Designed to cradle and contour your foot, creating an incredible underfoot sensation and supportive fit

    •  

    SPECS

  • Category: Structured Cushioning
  • Heel-to-toe Offset: 8mm (35mm heel/27mm forefoot)
  • Weight: Men's 8.8oz (249g)
  • Sustainability: This style is vegan and contains recycled materials

    • Sizing

    • Length: True to size
    • Width and toebox: A standard to slightly snug forefoot with a somewhat tapered, pointed toebox and mild mesh stretch. Standard and wide offered.

The Rundown

Light and plush for everyday miles

The ninth iteration of our award-winning Clifton franchise has launched, lighter and more cushioned than ever before. Eliminating weight while adding 3mm in stack height, the new Clifton 9 delivers a revitalized underfoot experience with a responsive new foam and improved outsole design. Removing overlays and hotmelts, the stripped back upper has been consciously crafted with a plusher heel, reflective heel panel, and streamlined tongue with single side medial gusset.

Sizing

  • Length: True to size, though a minority prefer a half size up
  • Width and toebox: Narrow toebox, one of the narrowest measured, and even the wide version runs narrower than most trainers. Regular and wide offered.
  • Fit notes: An overall snug fit with a slightly broader midfoot that gives a deceptive sense of room while the forefoot stays tight. Wide feet should take the wide, and for long-distance use go up a width rather than a length.

Description

Most people don’t make a routine out of a physically demanding activity that requires persistent effort to get any good at. Even fewer do that just for fun. It’s like we’ve always said – runners aren’t normal. We designed the 860 to keep up with the demands placed on shoes by the dedication of the stability-minded every day runner. The latest entry in the series, the Fresh Foam X 860v13, augments the pinnacle cushioning experience of Fresh Foam X with a supportive medial post to provide essential stability. Built for reliability over the long haul and sustained comfort over all distances, the 860 is a true go-to shoe.

Features
  • Fresh Foam X midsole foam with approximately 3% bio-based content delivers our most cushioned Fresh Foam experience for incredible comfort. Bio-based content is made from renewable resources to help reduce our carbon footprint.
  • Structured and breathable engineered mesh upper
  • Reflective accents designed to catch the light
  • Internal gusseted tongue for a secure fit
  • 10 mm drop; due to variances created during the development and manufacturing processes, all references to 10 mm drop are approximate

Sizing

  • Length: True to size
  • Width and toebox: An average-width toebox with a notably accommodating midfoot and a comparatively narrow heel. Multiple widths offered in men's and women's.
  • Fit notes: A relaxed, roomy upper that holds well, a minimal but effective heel counter for a stability shoe, and only a few runs of break-in. Sizing feedback is not unanimous, with some testers wanting a half size up and some wide-footed runners finding the standard width short on forefoot room, so a try-on is worthwhile.

Description

 

Equipe Nucleo is the latest running shoe designed for urban runners that live the city as their playground to train on, while thinking about the next challenge to come. “Nucleo” as the main feature - the intersole, core of this sneaker that stands out for its responsiveness and lightweight.

The intersole made with ourdd anima technology is engineered to provide the best performance, while taking care of feet protection and stability. Dd anima technology ensures a high degree of cushioning; High Rebound Compound increases the intersole responsiveness of 30% and reduces its weight for the 20%.

The sole is made in anti-abrasive rubber, with the special water-resistant Duratech 5000 compound on the heel.

Sizing

  • Length: Runs small; most runners will want a half size up
  • Width and toebox: Ample toebox room, neither notably wide nor narrow, with comfortable volume. A wide version is offered and is the better starting point for wide feet.
  • Fit notes: Reviewers found it ran short in their usual size and recommend a half size up, and several specialty retailers echo that. A rigid heel counter and the stock lacing give secure heel hold with no slippage. A standard everyday-trainer fit with no break-in required.

Details

The GT-2000™ 12 (Wide) shoe is a versatile stability trainer that's functional for various distances. We've reimagined this workhorse running style with less weight and a smoother heel-to-toe transition. ​

The midsole is updated with a full-length FF BLAST™ PLUS cushioning unit and PureGEL™ technology. These features help provide a more energized toe-off with cloud-like softness underfoot. ​

Meanwhile, the 3D GUIDANCE SYSTEM™ consists of wider basenets and an increased heel bevel and forefoot flare. As a result, you'll experience a silky-smooth transition from footstrike to toe-off.

Sizing

  • Length: True to size
  • Width and toebox: Standard toebox with a slight taper, average to slightly narrow through the midfoot and forefoot. Wide feet should go up a width. Multiple widths offered in men's and women's.
  • Fit notes: A very sturdy heel counter gives a firm ankle hold with no rubbing, and the thin gusseted tongue keeps the midfoot locked without excess instep volume. Essentially no break-in, and any initial awareness of the medial post disappears within the first run.

Description

Most people don’t make a routine out of a physically demanding activity that requires persistent effort to get any good at. Even fewer do that just for fun. It’s like we’ve always said – runners aren’t normal. We designed the 860 to keep up with the demands placed on shoes by the dedication of the stability-minded every day runner. The latest entry in the series, the Fresh Foam X 860v13, augments the pinnacle cushioning experience of Fresh Foam X with a supportive medial post to provide essential stability. Built for reliability over the long haul and sustained comfort over all distances, the 860 is a true go-to shoe.

Features
  • Fresh Foam X midsole foam with approximately 3% bio-based content delivers our most cushioned Fresh Foam experience for incredible comfort. Bio-based content is made from renewable resources to help reduce our carbon footprint.
  • Structured and breathable engineered mesh upper
  • Reflective accents designed to catch the light
  • Internal gusseted tongue for a secure fit
  • 10 mm drop; due to variances created during the development and manufacturing processes, all references to 10 mm drop are approximate

Sizing

  • Length: True to size
  • Width and toebox: An average-width toebox with a notably accommodating midfoot and a comparatively narrow heel. Multiple widths offered in men's and women's.
  • Fit notes: A relaxed, roomy upper that holds well, a minimal but effective heel counter for a stability shoe, and only a few runs of break-in. Sizing feedback is not unanimous, with some testers wanting a half size up and some wide-footed runners finding the standard width short on forefoot room, so a try-on is worthwhile.

Light. Responsive. And seriously quick. Lead training or racing in a shoe that's fast for everyone.

You wanted speed. So we added a spoon-shaped nylon blend Speedboard® that's stiff, strong and lighter than before. Added to a powerful forward roll to catapult you to new personal bests. Put simply, you'll feel it.

The ultra-light woven upper takes a cue from our fastest shoe yet – the Cloudboom Echo. The result? Breathability and performance that makes picking up the pace easier than ever.

Sizing

  • Length: True to size
  • Width and toebox: Medium, standard width with no radical tapering or toe cramping, and slightly more forefoot room than earlier Cloudflows. Standard width only.
  • Fit notes: No heel slippage with either light or midweight socks, and a midfoot hold reviewers described as a perfect wrap. The heel counter is notably flexible rather than stiff, and the forefoot is slightly snug with a light taper by design. No hot spots and no break-in needed.

Details

The GT-2000™ 12 (Wide) shoe is a versatile stability trainer that's functional for various distances. We've reimagined this workhorse running style with less weight and a smoother heel-to-toe transition. ​

The midsole is updated with a full-length FF BLAST™ PLUS cushioning unit and PureGEL™ technology. These features help provide a more energized toe-off with cloud-like softness underfoot. ​

Meanwhile, the 3D GUIDANCE SYSTEM™ consists of wider basenets and an increased heel bevel and forefoot flare. As a result, you'll experience a silky-smooth transition from footstrike to toe-off.

Sizing

  • Length: True to size
  • Width and toebox: Standard toebox with a slight taper, average to slightly narrow through the midfoot and forefoot. Wide feet should go up a width. Multiple widths offered in men's and women's.
  • Fit notes: A very sturdy heel counter gives a firm ankle hold with no rubbing, and the thin gusseted tongue keeps the midfoot locked without excess instep volume. Essentially no break-in, and any initial awareness of the medial post disappears within the first run.

The GEL-NIMBUS® 26 shoe's soft cushioning properties help you feel like you're landing on clouds. This design is revamped to help create a softer and smoother running experience.A soft engineered knit upper comfortably wraps your foot while supplying advanced ventilation. Additionally, the knit tongue and collar help provide a soft and supportive feel.By using FF BLAST™ PLUS ECO cushioning, this trainer creates a lighter and softer cushioning experience with less of an impact on the environment.Lastly, ASICS®GRIP™ outsole rubber helps create better traction, improved softness, and advanced durability.

Tech & Materials

  • Engineered knit upper
    Wraps the foot with a soft feel
  • At least 75% of the shoe's main upper material is made with recycled content to reduce waste and carbon emissions
  • The sockliner is produced with the solution dyeing process that reduces water usage by approximately 33% and carbon emissions by approximately 45% compared to the conventional dyeing technology
  • PureGEL® technology
    Helps provide lightweight cushioning and softer landings
  • FF BLAST™ PLUS ECO technology
    Cushioning creates a softer landing and a more responsive toe-off
  • OrthoLite™ X-55 sockliner
    Improves step-in comfort
  • Reflective details
    Designed to improve visibility in low-light conditions
  • AHAR®PLUS™ outsole rubber
    Improves durability
  • ASICS®GRIP™ outsole rubber
    Help create better traction, improved softness, and advanced durability

Sizing

  • Length: True to size
  • Width and toebox: Normal to wide forefoot with a stretchy upper, noticeably roomier than the tapered Nimbus 25. Normal heel, normal to slightly narrow midfoot. Wide widths available.
  • Fit notes: No heel slippage reported, with a snug midfoot from a thin but strongly gusseted tongue. Instep volume is fairly low as the upper sits close across the foot, though it stretches. The only break-in noted was mild pressure from the plush heel collar that faded with mileage.

The GT-2000™ 12 shoe is a versatile stability trainer that's functional for various distances. We've reimagined this workhorse running style with less weight and a smoother heel-to-toe transition.

The midsole is updated with a full-length FF BLAST™ PLUS cushioning unit and PureGEL™ technology. These features help provide a more energized toe-off with cloud-like softness underfoot.

Meanwhile, the 3D GUIDANCE SYSTEM™ consists of wider basenets and an increased heel bevel and forefoot flare. As a result, you'll experience a silky-smooth transition from footstrike to toe-off.

Product Details:

The Saucony Guide 17 has been fully transformed from top to bottom to provide seamless support and maximum cushioning for everyday runs, walks, and workouts.

Focusing on comfort and protection, the medial post has been replaced by a new era stability platform from Saucony's Center Path Technology. The update features a wider base, higher sidewalls, and an asymmetric profile that cradles the foot inside of the shoe to guide your stride smoothly through the gait cycle. This smoothness is further accentuated by the shoes' slightly lower heel-to-toe offset which has been moved from an 8mm drop down to a 6mm drop.

Built on a higher platform of PWRRUN foam throughout the midsole, this shoe not only provides more cushioning but also retains a fun and lively underfoot experience. The step-in feel is furthered enhanced by deep outsole flex grooves that add a touch of extra squishiness and bounce while the PWRRUN+ sock liner delivers a plush finish. The outsole blends strategically placed rubber with outsole grade EVA to deliver traction that doesn't interfere with the shoe's soft and lightweight feel.

In the upper, an updated Engineered Mesh provides an improved fit that wraps your feet securely with breathable comfort. Whether you're hitting the pavement for your daily runs or enjoying well-deserved recovery days, the Saucony Guide 17 is your dependable, supportive, and well-cushioned partner to help you reach your training goals.

Sizing

  • Length: True to size
  • Width and toebox: A standard-width, mid-range toebox with the usual taper at the very front, slightly wider in the forefoot than the Guide 16 thanks to stretchy mesh. Standard and wide offered.
  • Fit notes: The heel is slightly snug but well held by heavy collar padding and a moderately stiff counter, with a normal to slightly snug, well-gusseted midfoot that needs no lace fiddling. Volume accommodates thick or thin socks. Genuinely wide feet should go straight to the wide.

The ultra-light woven upper takes a cue from our fastest shoe yet – the Cloudboom Echo. The result? Breathability and performance that makes picking up the pace easier than ever.

Details

The GT-2000™ 12 shoe is a versatile stability trainer that's functional for various distances. We've reimagined this workhorse running style with less weight and a smoother heel-to-toe transition. ​

Description

Most people don’t make a routine out of a physically demanding activity that requires persistent effort to get any good at. Even fewer do that just for fun. Built for reliability over the long haul and sustained comfort over all distances, the 860 is a true go-to shoe.

The Saucony Triumph 22 is a reliable daily trainer designed to offer runners a highly cushioned underfoot experience for all-day comfort. This version has been elevated with an ultra-light and responsive PWRRUN PB super foam in the midsole tuned for daily mileage. Additionally, this shoe features improved geometry that includes a wider platform and updated rocker for a smooth and balanced ride. In the outsole, the full-length XT-900 rubber offers runners exceptional traction and long-lasting durability.

The Saucony Triumph 22 is complete with an engineered mesh upper and features an adaptive lacing system to ensure a snug and secure fit. Coupled with a soft heel collar lining and padded tongue, the Triumph 22 hugs your foot in long-lasting comfort. Overall, the Saucony Triumph 22 is a highly cushioned everyday running shoe with the versatility to handle everything from daily miles to weekend long runs and anything in between.

Sizing

  • Length: True to size
  • Width and toebox: Normal width with slightly higher volume through the forefoot and midfoot, roomier than previous Triumphs. Standard and wide offered.
  • Fit notes: Heel lockdown is excellent thanks to a heavily padded collar and a very stiff heel counter, while the thicker upper and gusseted tongue can feel a little baggy in the midfoot and may need a light lace snug. A plush rather than performance fit, so it feels less locked in at faster paces.

The Saucony Guide 17 has been fully transformed from top to bottom to provide seamless support and maximum cushioning for everyday runs, walks, and workouts.

Focusing on comfort and protection, the medial post has been replaced by a new era stability platform from Saucony's Center Path Technology. The update features a wider base, higher sidewalls, and an asymmetric profile that cradles the foot inside of the shoe to guide your stride smoothly through the gait cycle. This smoothness is further accentuated by the shoes' slightly lower heel-to-toe offset which has been moved from an 8mm drop down to a 6mm drop.

Built on a higher platform of PWRRUN foam throughout the midsole, this shoe not only provides more cushioning but also retains a fun and lively underfoot experience. The step-in feel is furthered enhanced by deep outsole flex grooves that add a touch of extra squishiness and bounce while the PWRRUN+ sock liner delivers a plush finish. The outsole blends strategically placed rubber with outsole grade EVA to deliver traction that doesn't interfere with the shoe's soft and lightweight feel.

In the upper, an updated Engineered Mesh provides an improved fit that wraps your feet securely with breathable comfort. Whether you're hitting the pavement for your daily runs or enjoying well-deserved recovery days, the Saucony Guide 17 is your dependable, supportive, and well-cushioned partner to help you reach your training goals.

Sizing

  • Length: True to size
  • Width and toebox: A standard-width, mid-range toebox with the usual taper at the very front, slightly wider in the forefoot than the Guide 16 thanks to stretchy mesh. Standard and wide offered.
  • Fit notes: The heel is slightly snug but well held by heavy collar padding and a moderately stiff counter, with a normal to slightly snug, well-gusseted midfoot that needs no lace fiddling. Volume accommodates thick or thin socks. Genuinely wide feet should go straight to the wide.

Designed to help provide adaptative on-demand stability, this shoe's support properties allow you to experience a smooth and balanced transition from footstrike to toe-off.

The midsole implements a full-length FF BLAST™ PLUS cushioning unit and PureGEL™ technology. These features help provide a more energized toe-off with cloud-like softness underfoot. ​

Tech

  • Jacquard mesh upper
    Offers a supportive and comfortable foothold
  • At least 50% of the shoe's main upper material is made with recycled content to reduce waste and carbon emissions
  • The sockliner is produced with the solution dyeing process that reduces water usage by approximately 33% and carbon emissions by approximately 45% compared to the conventional dyeing technology
  • 3D GUIDANCE SYSTEM™
    Helps provide advanced stability for a smoother stride
  • Rearfoot PureGEL™ technology
    Helps provide lightweight cushioning and softer landings
  • FF BLAST™ PLUS cushioning
    This material helps provide lightweight impact absorption and a responsive rebound
  • OrthoLite™ X-30 sockliner
    Helps provides soft step-in comfort
  • AHARPLUS™ heel plug rubber
    Helps improve durability
  • AHAR® LOW HARDNESS outsole material
    Helps improve resistance against wear
  • Reflective details
    Designed to help improve visibility in low-light settings

 

Sizing

  • Length: True to size
  • Width and toebox: Normal width but slightly snug overall, with a lower-volume upper than the GT-2000 12, particularly through the toebox, which has a light taper and a somewhat pointed shape. Standard, wide and extra-wide offered for men; standard and wide for women.
  • Fit notes: Very secure heel lockdown from large collar padding over a stiff rounded counter, with no irritation reported. The midfoot is snug. High-volume feet should go up a width rather than a length, so the stability geometry stays under the foot.

Ideal for overpronation:
  • Foot Type
    Low arches or flat feet

    The foot lands on outside of heel, then rolls inward (pronates) excessively, transferring weight to inner edge instead of ball of the foot.

The Saucony Triumph 22 is a reliable daily trainer designed to offer runners a highly cushioned underfoot experience for all-day comfort. This version has been elevated with an ultra-light and responsive PWRRUN PB super foam in the midsole tuned for daily mileage. Additionally, this shoe features improved geometry that includes a wider platform and updated rocker for a smooth and balanced ride. In the outsole, the full-length XT-900 rubber offers runners exceptional traction and long-lasting durability.

The Saucony Triumph 22 is complete with an engineered mesh upper and features an adaptive lacing system to ensure a snug and secure fit. Coupled with a soft heel collar lining and padded tongue, the Triumph 22 hugs your foot in long-lasting comfort. Overall, the Saucony Triumph 22 is a highly cushioned everyday running shoe with the versatility to handle everything from daily miles to weekend long runs and anything in between.

Sizing

  • Length: True to size
  • Width and toebox: Normal width with slightly higher volume through the forefoot and midfoot, roomier than previous Triumphs. Standard and wide offered.

Move your mind with the GEL-KAYANO® 31 shoe’s adaptive stability and premium comfort. ​​The 4D GUIDANCE SYSTEM™ helps provide adaptive stability. This helps you experience a more supportive and balanced stride during your distance training. ​​

Ideal for overpronation:
  • Foot Type
    Low arches or flat feet
  • Push Off
    Big toe and second toe do majority of the work.
  • Considered Injuries
    Shin splints, plantar fasciitis, bunions, heel spurs.
  • How your foot contacts the ground
    The foot lands on outside of heel, then rolls inward (pronates) excessively, transferring weight to inner edge instead of ball of the foot.

Sizing

  • Length: True to size

The midfoot is normal to slightly wide with a thick, well-gusseted tongue that locks down easily, and the toebox leaves room for swelling on long runs. No break-in noted.

Step into premium stability and plush comfort with the ASICS GEL-KAYANO® 32. Designed for long-distance runners and overpronators, this top-tier running shoe delivers a smoother, more supported stride—mile after mile.

Built with innovative cushioning and advanced support technology, the GEL-KAYANO® 32 is perfect for anyone looking to reduce fatigue and improve alignment during high-mileage training.

Key Features:

  • FF BLAST™ PLUS Cushioning: Lighter and more responsive than previous models, this foam offers a cloud-like ride with every step—without the added weight.

  • 4D GUIDANCE SYSTEM™ Technology: This adaptive system enhances stability and guides your foot for a more balanced, supportive stride.

  • Rearfoot PureGEL™ Technology: Softer than traditional GEL®, this upgraded shock-absorbing system improves comfort and impact protection during heel strike.

  • Breathable Engineered Mesh Upper: Lightweight and flexible mesh reduces the need for overlays while enhancing airflow and comfort.

  • Reinforced Tongue Wing & Knit Heel Tab: Offers a snug midfoot fit and makes putting the shoe on/off easier and more comfortable.

  • OrthoLite™ X-55 Sockliner: Delivers moisture-wicking cushioning for a cooler, drier in-shoe feel.

  • Hybrid ASICSGRIP™ Outsole: Combines ASICSGRIP™ rubber and AHARPLUS™ for superior traction on various surfaces and long-lasting durability.

  • Sustainable Sockliner Design: The solution-dyed sockliner cuts water use by 33% and carbon emissions by 45% compared to traditional dyeing methods.

  • Reflective Details: Enhance your visibility when running in low-light conditions.

Style #: 1011C052.002
UPC #: 197298890700

Sizing

  • Length: True to size
  • Width and toebox: Medium, slightly tapered toebox with a stretch-knit upper that adapts. Noticeably snugger than the 30 and 31, so best for normal-to-narrow feet. Standard, wide and extra-wide offered, and true wides should order the wide in their normal size.
  • Fit notes: A heavily padded heel collar and stiff heel counter give secure lockdown, which may bother very heel-sensitive runners. The gusseted tongue holds the midfoot well enough that no lace-lock is needed. The knit upper stretches and relaxes over the first few miles.

The GT-2000™ 14 shoe is designed to help provide a more energetic ride in a stable running experience. A trampoline outsole pod is positioned in the center of the outsole. This helps produce a more responsive toe-off. The midsole is updated with a FF BLAST™ MAX cushioning unit. Creating a more energized toe-off, this foam also offers cloud-like softness during the landing phase of your stride. Built for mild to moderate overpronators seeking reliable daily training support with responsive cushioning.

Sizing

  • Length: True to size
  • Width and toebox: Medium and on the narrower side, best for low-volume, narrow-to-medium feet, though some testers called it medium and never crowded. Wide and extra-wide offered for men, wide for women.
  • Fit notes: No hotspots or pinch points despite the thin tongue, though the tongue can irritate the instep, which crew or ankle socks solve. No meaningful break-in. Wide feet should go up a width rather than a size.

Experience the revolutionary Brooks Glycerin 22, featuring the game-changing DNA Tuned midsole technology. This premium men's running shoe delivers an exceptional balance of plush cushioning and responsive energy return, making it ideal for runners who demand maximum comfort without sacrificing performance.

Key Features:

  • DNA Tuned Cushioning: Nitrogen-infused dual-density foam with larger cells in the heel for soft landings and smaller cells in the forefoot for responsive toe-offs
  • Maximum Stack Height: 38.5mm heel / 28.2mm forefoot provides luxurious cushioning for long-distance comfort
  • 10mm Drop: Traditional offset promotes smooth heel-to-toe transitions
  • Double Jacquard Mesh Upper: Engineered knit construction offers breathability and adaptive fit
  • Premium Comfort: Plush padding in tongue and heel collar for immediate step-in luxury

Perfect For: Long runs, daily training, recovery days, and high-mileage runners who want a plush ride that still feels responsive. The Glycerin 22 excels for heel strikers and anyone seeking maximum cushioning with smooth transitions.

Weight: Approximately 10.2 oz (men's size 9/8) | Surface: Road running

Description

 

Equipe Nucleo is the latest running shoe designed for urban runners that live the city as their playground to train on, while thinking about the next challenge to come. “Nucleo” as the main feature - the intersole, core of this sneaker that stands out for its responsiveness and lightweight.

The intersole made with ourdd anima technology is engineered to provide the best performance, while taking care of feet protection and stability. Dd anima technology ensures a high degree of cushioning; High Rebound Compound increases the intersole responsiveness of 30% and reduces its weight for the 20%.

The sole is made in anti-abrasive rubber, with the special water-resistant Duratech 5000 compound on the heel.

FLUIDSUPPORT™ technology adapts to your changing biomechanical needs throughout each stride, providing guidance during key phases of the gait cycle while allowing natural foot motion for smooth, efficient transitions.

FF BLAST™ PLUS and FF BLAST™ MAX foams are combined in the midsole. These foams help create a blend of cloud-like softness and a responsive energy return while keeping the shoe lightweight.

Key Features:

Engineered mesh upper

A lightweight, breathable mesh material that reduces the need for additional overlays.

FLUIDSUPPORT™ technology

Support technology that adapts to the runner's changing biomechanical needs throughout each step. It helps provide comfort and guidance during critical phases of the gait cycle while allowing natural foot motion for smooth, efficient transitions.

Rearfoot PureGEL® technology

Softer, updated version of our GEL® technology that maintains the acclaimed properties that have made GEL® technology famous.Approximately 65% softer vs standard GEL® technology.

FF BLAST™ MAX cushioning

One of our most energetic midsole foams that's complemented with cloud-like softness and a responsive energy return in each step.

FF BLAST™ PLUS cushioning

Midsole foam that provides a blend of cloud like cushioning and a responsive ride that is lighter than FF BLAST™.

OrthoLite™ sockliner

Premium sockliner that provides cushioning performance and moisture management for a cooler, dryer environment.

HYBRID ASICSGRIP™ outsole

Combines ASICSGRIP™ rubber and AHARPLUS™ materials to help provide advanced grip for various terrains and advanced durability.

Reflective details

Visibility for enhanced nighttime and early-morning reflective brightness.

A breathable engineered woven upper adapts to the foot's natural movement for a secure, comfortable fit, while a new hybrid outsole combines ASICSGRIP rubber up front for wet-weather traction with durable AHAR LO at the heel. With a 41.5 mm heel stack and an 8 mm drop, it thrives on everyday miles, long runs and easy-to-uptempo efforts.

  • Outsole: ASICSGRIP forefoot + AHAR LO heel
  • Upper: Engineered woven mesh
  • Approx. weight: 249 g (men's 9) / 218 g (women's 8)
  • Surface: Road
  • Best for: Daily training, long runs, uptempo

The HOKA Clifton 11 is the latest version of HOKA's flagship daily trainer, tuned for plush, dependable comfort over everyday miles. It keeps the proven formula: a tall 42 mm heel stack, an 8 mm drop and HOKA's reliable compression-molded EVA midsole, paired with the early-stage MetaRocker geometry that rolls you smoothly through each stride.

For this release HOKA focused on fit and feel above the foam, with a softer new engineered mesh upper and a 3D-printed open-cell sockliner for a more comfortable, breathable ride. The wide, stable platform carries over from the 10, making it as good for long days on your feet as it is for easy runs.

  • Support type: Neutral
  • Heel-to-toe drop: 8 mm
  • Stack height: 42 mm heel / 34 mm forefoot (men), 38 / 30 mm (women)
  • Midsole: Compression-molded EVA (CMEVA)
  • Geometry: Early-stage MetaRocker
  • Upper: Engineered mesh with 3D-printed sockliner
  • Approx. weight: 281 g (men's 9)
  • Surface: Road
  • Best for: Daily training, easy runs, walking, all-day wear
